verdict.label: Light review
verdict.summary: MetaAds requires registering a custom OAuth app as Composio does not manage an app for this toolkit.

composioFit.summary: Composio does not provide a managed OAuth app for MetaAds, so you must create your own custom auth config and register an OAuth app.
whyOwnApp: Composio-managed OAuth is not available for METAADS.
You need your own Client ID and Client Secret in Composio.

phases.name: Register OAuth App
steps: Go to the MetaAds website registration page.
Complete the form with your information to create your CryptoAds account.
phases.handoff: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard.

phases.name: Configure Auth in Composio
steps: Open the Composio dashboard and navigate to auth configs.
Click Create Auth Config and select OAuth2 for METAADS.
Add the redirect URI from Composio to the MetaAds app configuration.
Paste the Client ID and Client Secret back into Composio.
phases.handoff: Ready to test authentication with your own account.

requirements.label: Privacy Policy
requirements.when: Required for platform registration and compliance with data practices.

scopes.purpose: General platform access and ad-tech integration services.

redirectRules.rule: Must use the exact redirect URI provided in the Composio dashboard.

blockers.cause: MetaAds does not expose a standard OpenID Connect discovery document at the root domain.
blockers.fix: Manually configure OAuth endpoints in your application or Composio settings if custom endpoints are required.
blockers.fallback: Use standard OAuth2 authorization and token URL endpoints provided by your MetaAds account manager.

blockers.cause: MetaAds lacks a standard OAuth metadata discovery endpoint.
blockers.fix: Configure the authorization and token endpoints manually using documentation or support guidance.
blockers.fallback: Reach out to MetaAds support for correct authorization URL paths.

checklist.text: Create a MetaAds account via the registration form.
Navigate to the Composio dashboard and initiate a new METAADS auth config.
Copy the redirect URI from Composio and configure it in MetaAds.
Paste Client ID and Client Secret into Composio.
Test connection with your personal account.

uncertainties: Exact token lifetimes and refresh token behavior are not documented.
Specific OAuth scope strings beyond standard OAuth2 login are not publicly detailed.
Detailed review requirements and production user caps are not explicitly stated.
